description: Inventory of the busted spec suite under spec/System. One entry per spec file: what it exercises, which mainOutput keys and ModStore queries it asserts on, and which migration issue has to land before it can be ported to xUnit. The per-file fields down to 'tests' are extracted mechanically from the sources; 'category', 'primaryUnblocker', 'unblockedBy' and 'note' are a hand review of each file. Regenerate the mechanical fields after any change to spec/System; Pob.Tests/SpecInventoryTests.cs fails if this file drifts out of date.

countsExplanation.byPrimaryUnblocker: files/tests whose single most direct blocker is this issue; every file counted once
countsExplanation.byAnyUnblocker: files/tests that list this issue anywhere in unblockedBy; files counted in several buckets

categories.engine: Needs the C# calc engine (issues 22-27). Cannot be ported today.
categories.domain: Needs the domain model, mod parser, item model or passive tree, but not the calc engine.
categories.platform: Needs the HTTP / OAuth / trade layer (issues 31-33).
categories.superseded: Another oracle already covers this ground; port only if that oracle proves thin.
categories.drop: Tests a Lua-language mechanism with no C# counterpart. Do not port.
